slides.title: Buying a Laval rental? Read these 5 numbers.
slides.sub: What CMHC's latest rental survey says, from Laval-des-Rapides to the whole island.

photo.credit: Near De La Concorde station, Laval-des-Rapides · Photo: Elli, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.title: Vacancy climbed to 3.4%
slides.body: More units sat empty than in years. Tenants have more choice, so build some vacancy into your numbers.
slides.source: Per CMHC via Courrier Laval & Desjardins, Dec 2025

slides.title: Average rent: $1,347 a month
slides.body: That's Laval's average across studios to big units. Compare it to the rents in the plex you're eyeing.
slides.source: Per CMHC via Courrier Laval, Dec 2025

slides.title: Units for rent ask $612 more
slides.body: New leases run higher than rents already in place. The leases you inherit set your starting income.
slides.source: Per CMHC via Courrier Laval, March 2026

slides.title: Pricier units sit empty more

photo.credit: Boulevard René-Laennec, Laval · Photo: Gaétan Veillette, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.body: Only **0.8%** of Laval's cheapest quarter of units sat vacant, versus **7.7%** of the priciest quarter.
slides.source: Per CMHC via Courrier Laval, October 2025 survey

slides.title: Laval-des-Rapides: rents up 20.7%

photo.credit: Place Bell, Laval-des-Rapides · Photo: Bryantriplex, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.body: Home of Place Bell and Montmorency metro. Three-bedroom-plus units went from **$1,002 to $1,368**.
slides.source: Per CMHC via FRAPRU & Courrier Laval, Dec 2025

slides.title: Eyeing a Laval plex? Let's run the numbers.
slides.tagline: I'll give it to you straight, no arrogance, no fluff.
